text:
sam: Heads-up: Lyra wants a Private POC. They require HSM-rooted keys, PKCS#11 access preferred, and short-lived client certs for our private runtime. Who's the presales owner?
elaine: I can run the presales handoff. We need a concise checklist for the customer and a clear set of transfer options (PKCS#11 over VPN, SCEP w/ OIDC, or manual CSR upload).
vikram: Security preference: PKCS#11 with attestation (vendor attestation cert or TPM-based proof). If they cannot do PKCS#11, accept SCEP for POC only with OIDC client assertion. Manual CSR only for bootstrap and flagged as limited.
carla: Ops note: Dedicated capacity question 15k inference qps? Wait, they said 200 qps with bursty traffic and ~800 concurrent sessions. That suggests 3x A100-equivalents baseline; i'll confirm after exact sequence lengths. For a 30-day trial we can do a discounted reserved commit.
sam: Elaine, can you enumerate exactly what we ask them to upload and what we provide back? I'll include it in the kickoff email.
elaine: Draft checklist: 1) CA cert chain (PEM) 2) HSM vendor/model/firmware + PKCS#11 module path or SCEP endpoint 3) Key policy (non-exportable, allowed operations) 4) CSR (if manual) and subject details 5) IP/CIDR allowlist for management plane and bastion 6) Bastion SSH pubkey and VPN contact 7) Desired cert TTL and rotation cadence 8) SIEM syslog/HTTPS endpoint for audit forward
vikram: Add: attestation artifact (HSM attestation cert or TPM quote), PKCS#11 sample sign vector (we ask them to sign nonce "lyra-onboard-<ts>"), and statement of compliance (SOC2 or ISO) if available. Also require declared key usage flags.
carla: Also confirm whether they want model pinning to the Dedicated pool or automatic fallback to hosted variants when overloaded. That changes capacity and the pricing model for the POC.
sam: Transport options proposed: A) PKCS#11 via customer VPN (preferred) B) SCEP + OIDC enrollment C) secure upload to presigned S3 or scoped SFTP. Which should we recommend as default for POC?
vikram: Recommend A for production. For POC allow B or C but mark those as limited (no attestation guarantee). Provide sample PKCS#11 commands for CSR generation they can run on their HSM host:
```
# on customer's HSM host
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/<vendor_pkcs11>.so -l --keypairgen --key-type rsa:3072 --id 01 --label lyra_key
# CSR using OpenSSL pkcs11 engine
openssl req -engine pkcs11 -keyform engine -new -key "pkcs11:object=lyra_key;type=private" -out lyra.csr -subj "/CN=lyra-client/O=LyraInc"
```
vikram: What we will issue back: short-lived client certs (TTL per their request between 24h-7d), a revocation endpoint (CRL/OCSP or API), and an attestation token tied to the Dedicated pool.
elaine: Secure transfer: offer temporary S3 bucket with pre-signed PUTs (MFA delete enabled) or an SFTP user scoped to /uploads/lyra. If they insist on encrypting at rest with their KMS CMK, we can accept encrypted blobs that our onboarding process will unwrap with their consent.
sam: Lyra also asked for audit log forwarding to their Splunk instance and 90-day retention. Add that to the onboarding questions.
carla: Operational decision: do they allow us to sign client certs with our ephemeral CA for the POC? If not, they must provide a CA-signed cert and chain which will increase time to onboard.
ops-bot: Ticket INF-5128 created: "lyra private-poc hsm onboarding & cert handoff" 1 assignee: elaine 1 due: 3 business days 1 https://rwd.atlassian/INF-5128
vikram: Security follow-ups to request from Lyra: signed ATO for POC, evidence of SOC2/ISO if possible, PKCS#11 sign vector, and their compromise/rotation plan.
sam: Timeline request to customer: provide artifacts and chosen transfer method within 5 business days so we can hit a 2-week POC start. I'll send the kickoff mail with the checklist and sample commands.
elaine: I'll draft the handoff email and attach the checklist + pkcs11 examples. Will update INF-5128 with any customer replies.
sam: Thanks all. I'll ping once Lyra confirms S3 vs SFTP vs VPN and whether they permit ephemeral CA signing. :rocket:
